name: RevokeUserPermission

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html operation to query the tenant ID
parameters.help_zh: 租户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/198073.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The user ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html operation to query the ID of the user
parameters.help_zh: 用户ID，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141938.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/147098.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: user_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object on which you want to revoke permissions from a user. Valid values:

*   **INSTANCE**: instances.
*   **DATABASE**: physical databases.
*   **LOGIC_DATABASE**: logical databases.
*   **TABLE**: physical tables.
*   **LOGIC_TABLE**: logical tables
parameters.help_zh:
权限类型，取值如下：
- **INSTANCE**：实例权限
- **DATABASE**：物理库权限
- **LOGIC_DATABASE**：逻辑库权限
- **TABLE**：物理表权限
- **LOGIC_TABLE**：逻辑表权限
parameters.name: ds_type

parameters.help_en: The database instance ID. You must specify this parameter if you revoke a permission from the database instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html operation to query the ID of the database instance
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，回收实例权限时需要指定。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141936.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141567.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The database ID. The database can be a physical database or a logical database.

*   To query the ID of a physical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation.
*   To query the ID of a logical database, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html or https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
数据库ID（DatabaseId），数据库分为物理库和逻辑库两种：
- 物理库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141873.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值。
- 逻辑库ID：可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141874.html或https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141876.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: db_id

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether the database is a logical database. Valid values:

*   **true**: The database is a logical database.
*   **false**: The database is a physical database.

> 

*   If the database is a logical database, set this parameter to **true**.

*   If the database is a physical database, set this parameter to **false**
parameters.help_zh:
是否为逻辑库，取值如下：
- **true**：逻辑库
- **false**：物理库

> - 如果您的数据库ID为逻辑库ID，此参数取值为**true**。
> - 如果您的数据库ID为物理库ID，此参数取值为**false**
parameters.name: logic

parameters.help_en: The table ID. You must specify this parameter if you revoke a permission from the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to query the table ID
parameters.help_zh: 表ID，回收表权限时需要指定。可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the table. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html operation to query the table name
parameters.help_zh: 表名，可通过调用接口https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/141878.html获取该参数的值
parameters.name: table_name

parameters.help_en:
The type of the permissions. Valid values:

*   **QUERY**: query permissions.
*   **EXPORT**: export permissions.
*   **CORRECT**: change permissions.
*   **LOGIN**: logon permissions.
*   **PERF**: query permissions on the performance details of an instance
parameters.help_zh:
权限类型，取值如下：
- **QUERY**：查询
- **EXPORT**：导出
- **CORRECT**：变更
- **LOGIN**：登录权限
- **PERF**：实例性能查看权限
parameters.name: perm_types
